positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead on the team responsible for:

 - Building and growing the web destination for Facebook Watch (www.facebook.com/watch)
 - Maintaining various core video product experiences across the Facebook site
 - Optimizing Facebook videos for search engines (SEO)
 - Enabling embedded player across various 3rd-party sites

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Implemented new sections for displaying content on the primary column of Facebook Pages, improving various metrics associated with user engagement.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed for the Knowledge Hubs division of the Slideshare team in San Francisco

positions.title: Fluid Interfaces UROP
positions.description: Used Google glass and pupil eye-tracking to create an app that helps students augment their learning.

positions.title: Web Application Developer Intern
positions.description: Developed internal recruiting tools which automated part of the recruiting process and provided analytics to promote company-wide engagement.

positions.title: Infolab UROP
positions.description: Research involves information access using natural language processing. Specialized in data mining, backend database management, and caching.

positions.title: Team Captain/Team Member
positions.description: Acted as team captain for ARML and PUMaC contests. Also participated in NYCIML, NYSML, Mandelbrot, AMC, and AIME.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description: Programmed robots using to perform tasks aboard the international space station. Focused on spacecraft docking, formation flight, and autonomous collaboration. Team won 5th out of 24 in the finals.

honors.title: NYSCEF Finalist
honors.description: Received silver medal for original math research paper involving game theory.
honors.issuer: Issued by New York City Science and Engineering Fair · Mar 2012

honors.title: PSAT/NMSQT Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: Selected to receive one of the 2,500 National Merit $2,500 Scholarships.

projects.title: ModelDB
projects.description: ModelDB is an end-to-end system that tracks machine learning models as they are built, extracts and stores relevant metadata (e.g., hyperparameters, data sources) for models, and makes this data available for easy querying and visualization.

projects.title: SET® Android Game
projects.description: Faithful rendition of one of my favorite card games, SET.
